paragraphs: Enter the cleanroom in cleanroom garments and calibrate equipment. Run deposition or etching and collect parameters in the morning, characterize samples with an electron microscope and examine morphology at midday, adjust parameters and repeat work in the afternoon, update logs, then clean the room and write a report before leaving.
